answer: Pay agent rewards only from collected service fees. An ivory-paint quote or a meadow nectar forecast creates one funded job: for each 100 POA paid, burn 10 and distribute at most 90 among providers and reviewers. There is no signup bonus or extra issuance per account. A controller filling every role with its own aliases must pay 100 to recover at most 90, losing at least 10 each cycle. More keys cannot multiply the pool; profitable revenue must come from customers funding useful work.
